description: Small English engineering/study retrieval regression set. Not a representative production benchmark.

documents.title: Replica acknowledgement
documents.text: A replicated database accepts a write after a majority of replicas acknowledge it. With five replicas, three acknowledgements form a quorum.

documents.title: Safe repeated payments
documents.text: A payment service records an operation key. Repeated delivery of the same request returns the stored result instead of charging the customer twice.

documents.title: Durable event publication
documents.text: A transaction writes both the business update and an event record into the same database. A background relay publishes that record to a message broker.

documents.title: Meaning-based indexing
documents.text: A search system represents text as dense numeric vectors. Nearest-neighbor comparison finds related passages even when they use different words.

documents.title: Tablet writing input
documents.text: A tablet ignores touches from the hand resting on the screen while a stylus writes strokes. The pen remains the active drawing input.

documents.title: Recovery drills
documents.text: Backups are encrypted snapshots stored outside the live database. A recovery drill restores a snapshot into an isolated environment and checks that records can be read.

documents.title: Expiring queue claims
documents.text: A worker claims a queue item for a limited time. If the worker crashes, another worker can claim the item after the claim expires. A unique fencing token prevents the old worker from committing stale results.

documents.title: Scheduled study sessions
documents.text: Study sessions revisit material on a schedule. Correct answers lengthen the interval before the next review; forgotten answers shorten it.
